bridge-type.label: BMW CarData Account
bridge-type.description: Access to the vehicles of a BMW Group customer account via BMW CarData

parameter.name: clientId
parameter.label: Client ID
parameter.description: The client ID created in the BMW CarData section of the MyBMW / MINI customer portal. The client needs the subscriptions "CarData API" and "CarData Streaming".

parameter.name: streaming
parameter.label: Streaming
parameter.description: Receive vehicle data pushed by the CarData streaming service. The data selected for the stream in the customer portal is updated as soon as the vehicle reports it.
